full_text: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued an orange color warning for heavy to very heavy rainfall along with thunderstorms and lightning over Odisha and Bihar today. The IMD has forecast heavy rainfall over Chhattisgarh, East Madhya Pradesh, East Uttar Pradesh, and Jharkhand during the day. Similar conditions are predicted over Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Andhra Pradesh, North Interior Karnataka, Odisha, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Karaikal and Uttarakhand during the same period. According to the IMD, Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh, Gilgit, Baltistan, Muzaffarabad, South Interior Karnataka, West Bengal and Sikkim are also expected to witness thunderstorms along with lightning and gusty winds today.

The IMD’s initial long-range forecast in April had projected June-September rainfall at roughly 92% of the long-term average, largely due to the expected onset of El Niño. That below-normal prediction has largely played out with sharp fluctuations.
Cumulative rainfall sat nearly 40% below normal by mid-June before periodic active spells narrowed the gap, leaving national figures around 12% below average by early August.
